build_MistralToolParser: build a MistralToolParser instance with a tokenizer and list of tools for parsing Mistral model tool calls
create_MistralStreamingResult: create a MistralStreamingResult dataclass with delta message, reasoning state, and tool call tracking fields
extract_tool_calls: extract tool calls from a complete Mistral model response string split by the tool call token
